title: HealthResponse
description: Body of a 200 response to GET /app/v1/health. Mirrors the agent's existing /health surface (nightshift-client/idea.md 3.5). Liveness is authenticated like every other route — see contracts/app-ingress.md invariant 1.

ok.description: True when the agent considers itself healthy. A 200 with ok:false is a valid, meaningful response — the agent is reachable but degraded.

version.description: Agent version string. Opaque to the client; no format is imposed.

uptimeSec.description: Seconds since the agent process started.
